skill_name: Come up with an idea for creating a mobile application that could help people with mental health.
workflow: I would create a mobile application that provides access to mental health resources and support. This app would provide users with a toolkit of resources that could help them manage their mental health. These resources could include educational materials about different disorders and their treatments, a platform for tracking their moods, resources for finding mental health professionals, and access to a supportive online community through forums and chat rooms.
